assets.name: LowPoly RPG Characters (Warrior, Ranger, Rogue, Wizard, Cleric, Monk)
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.attribution: Made by Quaternius (CC0); adapted for Midnights Manner. Attribution voluntary.
modifications: FBX armature and actions converted to GLB with FBX2glTF v0.9.7
animation channels sampled at fixed clip fractions and CPU linear-blend skinned offline
weapon mesh nodes excluded at bake time (the gear system draws weapons)
texture sampled per triangle and quantized to a shared flat palette
quadric-decimated to hi 260 / lo 110 face budgets, grounded at 1.1 tiles
glTF Y-up converted to game Z-up (x, -z, y)
no runtime glTF, texture, skin or animation loader is added
poses: stand Idle@0.0, walk-a Walk@0.0, walk-b Walk@0.5, attack class clip@0.45
gameSystems: baked villager pose bodies (R3 role groups)
